'''Tarivo III''' was an object<ref name="RF">''[[Rebel Force: Trapped]]''</ref> located in the [[Lantillian sector/Legends|Lantillian sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the assassin [[X-7]] learned [[Ptann]] fighting techniques on Tarivo III.<ref name="RF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tarivo III was first mentioned<ref name="RF" /> in the novel ''[[Rebel Force: Trapped]]'', which was written by [[Alex Wheeler]] and released in [[2010]].<ref name="ERC" /> Later, the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the [[Tarivo system/Legends|Tarivo star system]], and thereby Tarivo itself, in grid square P-9.<ref name="EAOC" />
